most_similar_reason: Candidate 1 shares the core pattern of a god murdered (repeatedly) by jealous brothers who covet his rule, revived through a female relative's intervention, who then defeats those brothers, marries multiple goddesses, civilizes and develops the land with a helper figure, and finally withdraws to rule the netherworld — matching the target's fratricide, resurrection, vengeance, culture-bringing, and lordship of the dead.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 10 is a bare account of an ancestor-turned-creator who makes humans from reeds and then forgets and abandons them, with no murder, no dismemberment, no searching spouse, no avenging son, and no rule over the dead.
